headline: Friday's your reset point—no snacking, reclaim your pace
summary: You're gaining +0.38 kg/week when you need -0.86 kg/week; Friday's emotional eating choice will define your entire weekend trajectory.
details: Eat only portioned Huel and whole foods today—no emotional snacking, no processed foods. Get 45 minutes on the rowing machine or treadmill after work to build momentum. Today matters because Friday is where your weekend weakness starts; you break that cycle now or gain another 2 kg in the next month.
